summary: The agent provides a well-structured solution with a proper time-based validation split and sensible per-meter modelling. However, the model suffers from target leakage due to naive target encoding applied directly to the training set without out-of-fold estimation. Additionally, the stochastic LightGBM models are evaluated only once, and model performance is measured using a single metric.
